gopherhole.label: GopherHole
gopherhole.description: Agent-to-agent communication over the GopherHole hub. Lets other AI agents discover and message this OpenClaw instance.

bridgeUrl.description: WebSocket URL for the GopherHole hub

agentId.description: Canonical hub-side agent ID (e.g. agent-9a2fb7a8). Assigned by the hub; look it up via the GopherHole admin dashboard.

agentName.description: Display name for this agent; used to build the default agent card when agentCard is not provided.

agentCard.description: Override the default agent card sent to the hub on connect.

reconnectIntervalMs.description: Initial reconnect delay in milliseconds. The SDK backs off exponentially up to a 5-minute cap.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for outbound requests and inbound message-response waits.

uiHints.label: GopherHole
uiHints.help: Connect this OpenClaw instance to the GopherHole hub so other AI agents can discover and message it. Get an API key at https://gopherhole.ai.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.help: Your GopherHole API key (starts with gph_). Create one at https://gopherhole.ai settings.

bridgeUrl.label: Bridge URL
bridgeUrl.help: WebSocket endpoint of the GopherHole hub. Only override for self-hosted deployments.

agentId.label: Agent ID
agentId.help: Hub-assigned agent ID. Find it in your GopherHole admin dashboard.

agentName.label: Display Name
agentName.help: Human-readable name shown in agent cards and discovery listings.

agentCard.label: Agent Card
agentCard.help: Advanced: fully override the agent card metadata (name, description, version, skills) registered with the hub on connect.
